*Campaign aims to raise more than $45,000 on Oct. 16, 2026, in support of organic integrity*


LAKEWOOD, Colo.


, Oct. 8, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- In recognition of[World Food Day](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4777199-1&h=524180141&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.fao.org%2Fworld-food-day%2Fabout%2Fen&a=World+Food+Day) on Oct. 16,[Natural Grocers®,](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4777199-1&h=3176253296&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2F&a=Natural+Grocers%C2%AE%2C) the nation's leading family-operated organic and natural grocery retailer, will once again host a one-day, in-store fundraising campaign benefiting[The Cornucopia Institute.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4777199-1&h=3456530932&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cornucopia.org%2Fabout-us%2F&a=The+Cornucopia+Institute.) Natural Grocers has pledged to donate 1% of sales from all stores nationwide, with a goal of raising more than $45,000 for the nonprofit.


**SUPPORTING ORGANIC INTEGRITY TOGETHER** Customers are invited to[shop at their local Natural Grocers](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4777199-1&h=2887958734&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Fstore-directory&a=shop+at+their+local+Natural+Grocers) on Oct. 16 to participate in the company's second annual World Food Day fundraiser for The Cornucopia Institute. 1% of the day's sales will be donated to support the organization's work to safeguard the integrity of organic labeling, production, processing and marketing.


"World Food Day reminds us that everyday choices at the grocery store can help shape the future of food," said Raquel Isely, vice president of marketing at Natural Grocers. "We are proud to continue our support of The Cornucopia Institute and its important work to protect organic integrity for generations to come."


**THE CORNUCOPA INSTITUTE** The Cornucopia Institute is a nonprofit watchdog for organic food and a trusted resource for organic advocates seeking to align their purchases with their values. Through consumer tools, policy work, and investigations into the organic marketplace, Cornucopia works to uncover the truth behind organic food and advocate for an organic label consumers and retailers can trust.


Cornucopia Executive Director Melody Morrell says, "Natural Grocers is turning a single day of shopping into a powerful investment in our food future. Together, we are driving demand for the best organic food, ensuring tomorrow's innovative organic brands have a chance, and keeping dedicated organic farmers on the land."

**ABOUT NATURAL GROCERS BY VITAMIN COTTAGE**
Founded in 1955,[Natural Grocers by Vitamin Cottage, Inc.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4777199-1&h=4088457669&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.naturalgrocers.com%2F&a=Natural+Grocers+by+Vitamin+Cottage%2C+Inc.) (NYSE: NGVC) is an expanding specialty retailer of natural and organic groceries, body care products and dietary supplements. The grocery products sold by Natural Grocers must meet strict quality guidelines and may not contain artificial flavors, preservatives or sweeteners (as defined by its standards), synthetic colors or partially hydrogenated or hydrogenated oils. The Company sells only USDA-certified organic produce and exclusively pasture-raised, non-confinement dairy products and free-range eggs. Natural Grocers' flexible smaller-store format allows it to offer affordable prices in a shopper-friendly, clean and convenient retail environment. The Company also provides extensive free science-based Nutrition Education programs to help customers and Crew make informed health and nutrition choices. Natural Grocers is committed to its[Five Founding Principles](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4777199-1&h=1278909308&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Four-five-founding-principles&a=Five+Founding+Principles) —including its "Commitment to Community" and "Commitment to Crew." In fiscal year 2025, the Company invested more than $16 million in incremental compensation and discretionary payments for Crew. Headquartered in Lakewood, CO, Natural Grocers has 175 stores in 22 states. Visit[naturalgrocers.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4777199-1&h=1381188081&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2F&a=naturalgrocers.com) for more information and store locations.


**THE CORNUCOPIA INSTITUTE** The Cornucopia Institute is a[tax-exempt, charitable organization](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4777199-1&h=2457526880&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cornucopia.org%2Fwp-content%2Fuploads%2F2016%2F11%2FCornucopia-IRS-Letter-of-Determination.pdf&a=tax-exempt%2C+charitable+organization) incorporated in 2004. Its work is supported primarily through individual donor contributions from farmers and consumers. They do not solicit or receive any government funds. The Cornucopia Institute is your watchdog, bringing you the truth behind organic. This nonprofit charity partners with independent retailers and co-ops to share and amplify tools that grow demand for the best organic farms and brands. Follow them on[Facebook](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4777199-1&h=3906818025&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2FCornucopia.Institute&a=Facebook) ,[Instagram](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4777199-1&h=4041735665&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fcornucopiainstitute%2F&a=Instagram) ,[BlueSky](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4777199-1&h=1807926630&u=https%3A%2F%2Fbsky.app%2Fprofile%2Fcornucopia-inst.bsky.social&a=BlueSky) and[YouTube](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4777199-1&h=849324748&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fchannel%2FUCfNdcu52aSgVtaOjKG6fCZQ&a=YouTube) .
